requirements.title: LEAD ENGINEER - PS MODEM
requirements.jdText:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Satellite Communication Engineer with strong expertise in satellite communication systems and data networking technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and maintain satellite communication networks and ground segment infrastructure.
  • Configure and troubleshoot VSAT systems.
  • Implement and manage IP-based data communication services.

Experience: 3-8 Years

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

Location: Bangalore
requirements.jd_summary: Seeking a Satellite Communication Engineer to design, deploy, and maintain satellite-based data networks and ground-segment infrastructure, ensuring reliable, mission-critical connectivity in Bangalore.
